topic: Multi-agent AI deliberation is a new category. No one owns it yet. We have a working platform that assembles AI agents with distinct expertise into structured debates, competitive ideation, and review loops. Analyze: what adjacent markets could this disrupt? What existing workflows and budgets does it replace? Where is there a billion-dollar-plus market with no AI solution that structured multi-agent debate could crack open? Think consulting, governance, education, hiring, compliance, investment committees, product development, policy-making, legal strategy, medical diagnosis, creative development. Where does the puck go in 5 years and how do we get there first?
